info.name: Ignition Gateway REST access-control redundancy API

items.docs: Information on the current status of the redundancy system.
The configuration of the redundancy system. Note that the gatewayNetworkSetup section only applies to the redundant backup.
Updates the configuration of the redundancy system.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Return all logs since this timestamp (in epoch millis).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip before returning results.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The name of a field to sort by. Use `asc(fieldName)` or `desc(fieldName)`
to specify the sort direction as ascending or descending, respectively.

params.name: search
params.description: A search string to filter items by. Terms separated by whitespace.

params.name: key_0
params.description: Filter items by field name, using format like `fieldName[op]=value` where `op` is one of: `eq` (equals), `ne` (not equals), `cn` (contains), `sw` (starts with), `ew` (ends with), `gt` (greater than), `gte` (greater than or equal), `lt` (less than), `lte` (less than or equal), `rgx` (regular expression).

items.docs: Returns log events from the redundancy system.
Forces redundant configuration to failover to the backup node.
